    sandbox.set_material_properties(wheel1, restitution=0.1, friction=0.2)
    sandbox.set_material_properties(wheel2, restitution=0.1, friction=0.2)
    
    # Add joints between torso and wheels with expanded rotation limits
    pivot1 = sandbox.add_joint(torso, wheel1, anchor_point=(wheel1.position.x, start_y - torso_height/2), type='pivot', lower_limit=-0.5, upper_limit=0.5)
    pivot2 = sandbox.add_joint(torso, wheel2, anchor_point=(wheel2.position.x, start_y - torso_height/2), type='pivot', lower_limit=-0.5, upper_limit=0.5)
    
    return {"body": torso, "joints": [pivot1, pivot2]}

def agent_action(sandbox, agent_body, step_count):
    joints = _get_joints(agent_body)
    torso = agent_body.get("body") if isinstance(agent_body, dict) else None
    if torso is not None:
        # Calculate the desired motor speed based on position
        if torso.position.x >= 25.0:
            rotation_speed = 0.0
        else:
            rotation_speed = 0.05  # Low speed to avoid joint limits
        # Apply opposite motor speeds to left and right wheels
        sandbox.set_motor(joints[0], -rotation_speed, max_torque=100.0)  # Left wheel
        sandbox.set_motor(joints[1], rotation_speed, max_torque=100.0)   # Right wheel
